app.title: LGR Desktop
app.subtitle: This app opens LGR. There is no local mode and no local data.

overview.title: Overview
overview.name: Name
overview.openLgrHint: Opens the LGR app in its own window.
overview.openLgrBrowserHint: Opens the LGR app in your browser.
overview.fiscalDevicesNone: No fiscal devices are assigned to this desktop.
overview.updatesHint: Check whether a newer version is available.
overview.updatesManaged: Updates for this computer are installed by whoever manages it.
overview.updateDeferred: The till is in use — the update will install shortly.
overview.autoUpdateOff: Automatic updates are off. Updates install only when you press Install.

notRegistered.title: This desktop is not registered
notRegistered.body: Register it so an administrator can give it a name, a start page and fiscal devices.

revoked.title: This desktop was removed from {org}
revoked.body: It can no longer reach the server. Ask an administrator for a new registration code, then set this desktop up again.

keyInFile.title: The desktop key is stored in a file
keyInFile.body: This system has no secret store, so the key is in a file readable only by this account. It works, but anyone who can read this account's files can read the key.

clockSkew.title: This computer's clock is {minutes} minutes out
clockSkew.body: Sign-in and fiscal receipts depend on the time being right. Correct the clock in the operating system's date and time settings — LGR never changes it for you.

updateRequired.title: An update is required
updateRequired.body: The server will not accept this version any more.

serverUnreachable.title: The server cannot be reached
serverUnreachable.body: Nothing works offline. Check the network, then try again.

settings.title: Settings
settings.serverUrlHint: Where this desktop looks for LGR.

serverUrlChange.title: Change the server address?
serverUrlChange.body: This desktop is registered with {current}. Changing the address removes that registration, and you will need a new code to register against {next}.

settings.desktopNameHint: What this machine calls itself in the Desktops list.
settings.autostart: Start LGR Desktop when I sign in
settings.openLgrOnLaunch: Open LGR as soon as the app starts
settings.openLgrOnLaunchHint: A till shows the point of sale after a reboot with nobody touching it.
settings.openInSystemBrowser: Open LGR in my browser instead of its own window
settings.systemBrowserMaster: A shop server always opens in LGR Desktop’s own window.
settings.autoUpdateHint: Checks every 4 hours and installs new versions. Waits while the till is printing a receipt.
settings.proxyHint: Leave empty to use the system proxy. The system's certificates are used either way.
settings.rotateKeyHint: Replaces this desktop's key. It stays registered; tokens issued with the old key stop working.

rotateKeyConfirm.title: Rotate this desktop's key?
rotateKeyConfirm.body: The current key is replaced immediately. This desktop stays registered.

settings.rotateKeyNeedsRegistration: This desktop is not registered, so there is no key to rotate.

onboarding.title: Set up this desktop
onboarding.serverIntro: Where does this desktop find LGR?
onboarding.serverUpgraded: Addresses are opened over a secure connection, so this was changed to {url}.
onboarding.serverInvalid: That does not look like a server address.
onboarding.serverHintLan: A server in your shop: type its address as its Desktops page shows it, for example https://192.168.1.10:4443.
onboarding.compareWords: This is an LGR Server on your network. Check that its Desktops page shows these six words, in this order:
onboarding.fingerprintVerified: This server's certificate matches the registration link:
onboarding.fingerprintMismatch: This server's certificate does not match the registration link. Do not continue: ask your administrator for a new code.
onboarding.notAMaster: The registration link is for an LGR Server, but this address does not answer as one.
onboarding.nameIntro: What should this machine be called in the Desktops list?
onboarding.codeIntro: Ask an administrator for a registration code from Settings → Desktops.
onboarding.codeFromLink: This code came from a link. Check it is the one you were given before continuing.
onboarding.optionsIntro: You can change any of this later in Settings.

diagnostics.title: Diagnostics
diagnostics.intro: A diagnostics bundle collects this desktop's settings, its recent logs and its version into one file you can send to support. It contains no password and no key.

notInShell.title: Opened in a browser
notInShell.body: These pages belong to the LGR Desktop app. In a browser they render, but nothing can read this machine's settings, so values are blank.
